description: This file contains a set of tests for verifying the behavior of git operations such as cloning, fetching, and object management, using a shell testing framework. It automates various git scenarios including shallow clones, object copying, and ref handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, with a label describing the scenario.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the filesystem timestamp to ensure proper test timing.

methods.name: git init-db
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository without default configurations.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Adds files to the staging area.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Commits staged changes with a message.

methods.name: git count-objects
methods.description: Counts the number of loose and packed objects in the repository.

methods.name: git remote add
methods.description: Adds a new remote URL to the repository.

methods.name: git rev-list
methods.description: Lists objects reachable from a given commit.

methods.name: git pack-objects
methods.description: Creates a packfile from input objects.

methods.name: git fetch
methods.description: Fetches objects and refs from a remote repository.

methods.name: git gc
methods.description: Runs garbage collection to optimize repository storage.
